levelsSection.title: Six German courses, A1 to C2

faq.q: Which German course in Dehradun is right for me?
faq.a: Choose by your goal and your current level. Beginners start at A1; learners preparing for work, Ausbildung or visa applications often aim for B1; many German-taught university programmes ask for B2 or C1. A free level check tells you where to start.

faq.q: What is the difference between the A1, A2, B1, B2, C1 and C2 German levels?
faq.a: They are the six levels of the Common European Framework of Reference (CEFR). A1 and A2 are basic, B1 and B2 are independent, and C1 and C2 are proficient. Each level has its own Goethe-Zertifikat exam.

faq.q: Do all German courses at Language Zone follow the Goethe-Zertifikat?
faq.a: Yes. Each German course in Dehradun follows the syllabus of its Goethe-Zertifikat and trains all four exam skills: Lesen (reading), Hören (listening), Schreiben (writing) and Sprechen (speaking).

faq.q: Where do I take the Goethe exam if I study German in Dehradun?
faq.a: Goethe exams are held at Goethe-Institut centres and their licensed exam partners, such as the Goethe-Institut in New Delhi. Check the Goethe-Institut website for current centres and dates; our trainers guide you through choosing a date and registering.

faq.q: Can I join a higher German level directly?
faq.a: Yes. If you already know some German, our trainers assess your speaking, grammar and vocabulary in a short level check and place you in the A2, B1, B2, C1 or C2 batch that fits.

faq.q: Are German classes in Dehradun available on weekends or evenings?
faq.a: We run morning and evening batches and personalised sessions, so students and working professionals in Dehradun can fit German classes around college or work. Ask us for the current batch timings.
